description: SSIS packages as Dagster assets. Discovers SSISDB.catalog.packages + optionally executes via create_execution/start_execution + polls to completion, subsettable (selecting one package runs only that package). Fivetran-shape workspace: block for connection + selector for filtering + assets_by_package for per-package overrides/deps + polling_sensor + freshness_lag_threshold_seconds. demo_mode runs the whole shape with a synthetic catalog and zero SQL Server dependency.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per SSIS package discovered in SSISDB.catalog.packages. With `action: noop` (default) each asset is declare-only (external asset). With `action: execute` each materialization calls `SSISDB.catalog.create_execution + set_execution_parameter_value + start_execution` (per package_overrides) and polls to completion. No inputs — SSIS runs its own pipelines. Optional `polling_sensor` emits AssetObservation per completed execution; optional freshness check per package.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.description: Connection to SQL Server hosting SSISDB (SQLAlchemy URL or flat fields).

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Skip the real SQL Server connection entirely. Discovery returns a synthetic 2-package catalog; execute/poll, the observation sensor, and freshness checks all log a simulated SSIS lifecycle instead of running real T-SQL.

package_selector.label: Package Selector
package_selector.description: Filter which SSISDB packages become Dagster assets. Omit for all packages.

assets_by_package.label: Assets By Package
assets_by_package.description: Override the asset spec for specific packages, keyed by qualified name '<folder>/<project>/<package>'. Mirrors the official dagster-databricks DatabricksWorkspaceComponent.assets_by_task_key shape. Use deps: to declare real run-order between packages -- with action=execute, a selected dependency runs before the package that depends on it.

action.label: Action
action.description: noop = external asset (declare-only); execute = create_execution + start_execution + poll. execute is subsettable (can_subset=true) -- selecting one package only runs that package (plus any assets_by_package dependency ahead of it), not every discovered package.

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: Only used when action=execute. If true, poll until terminal status; if false, return once SSIS accepts the trigger.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Overall timeout for a synchronous execution. Set 0 for no timeout.

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: If true, emit a sensor that polls SSISDB.catalog.executions for completions and emits AssetObservation per package.

freshness_lag_threshold_seconds.label: Freshness Lag Threshold (seconds)
freshness_lag_threshold_seconds.description: If set, attach an asset check per package that fails when the last successful execution is older than this threshold.

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Applies the SAME partitions_def to every imported package: 'daily'|'weekly'|'monthly'|'hourly'|'static'|'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned (default). The observation sensor can only derive a partition key for time-based types (from each execution's end_time) -- static/dynamic types attach the partitions_def to the asset but the sensor cannot auto-tag observations against them.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for time-based partition types (e.g. '2024-01-01').

partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).
partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule

partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.
partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
